rundown: Real Kashmir beat Dempo SC 3-1 at TRC Turf Ground in Srinagar. Real Kashmir led 2-1 at half-time and never looked back.
Goals: Dempo SC Rowllin Borges 35'; Real Kashmir Ningthoukhongjam Rohen Singh 19', Alain Eyenga 33', Marcus Joseph 87'.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 23, 7:56 AM ET. It had Dempo SC 33%, the draw 27% and Real Kashmir 40%, projecting Dempo SC 1.3 – Real Kashmir 1.5 (2.8 total, Real Kashmir by 0.2).

Final: Dempo SC 1 – Real Kashmir 3. Right winner: it had Real Kashmir at 40%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Dempo SC came in with a 11% below average attack and a 13% stingier than average defense (3-0-1, 1.5 scored and 1 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 24 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.3, they scored 1 (−0.3 goals, 25% under); projected to allow 1.5, they allowed 3 (+1.5 goals, 102% over).

Real Kashmir came in with a 3% above average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (0-2-1, 1.3 scored and 2 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 22 and 22 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.5, they scored 3 (+1.5 goals, 102% over); projected to allow 1.3, they allowed 1 (−0.3 goals, 25% under).

The bigger miss was Real Kashmir's scoring (+1.5 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 4 against 2.8 projected (+1.2), about the 76th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Real Kashmir by 2 against Real Kashmir by 0.2 projected, about the 86th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Form (DSC 2-1 L5 · KAS 1-2 L5): Real Kashmir ×0.99, Dempo SC ×1.01. It favored Dempo SC, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (DSC lineup rating or past seasons, KAS lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.289 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +1.8 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1806 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections so far: Dempo SC attack ×1.040, defense ×1.040 (7 games); Real Kashmir attack ×1.040, defense ×1.022 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 1.8 goals), no bet.
